title: Juicy Easy Dutch Peas Stamppot
description: Sweet and juicy one-pot Dutch dish featuring jalapeno, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Place the Russet potatoes, smoked bacon, butter, and onion in a pressure cooker.
Cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.
Add the jalapeno peppers, garlic, and green peas to the pressure cooker.
Close the lid and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Use a pressure cooker to quickly cook the stamppot, which will help retain the nutrients and flavor of the ingredients.
Once the cooking time is up, quick-release the pressure and let the stamppot rest for a few minutes.
Serve the stamppot hot, garnished with additional jalapeno peppers if desired.
This dish is a variation of a traditional Dutch recipe, adapted to include a spicy kick from the jalapeno peppers.
Adjust the amount of jalapeno peppers to your desired level of spiciness.
This recipe is suitable for a weeknight dinner, as it is quick and easy to prepare.
The combination of smoked bacon and green peas provides a sweet and savory flavor profile.
The Russet potatoes add a comforting and filling texture to the dish.
